title: Fixed overlapping digram encoding constrains latent endpoints
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: each literal written symbol encodes a fixed ordered pair of unknown latent symbols. Adjacent written symbols overlap by one latent symbol. Exact endpoint equalities test all such assignments without choosing a plaintext alphabet.

design.mechanism: Fixed map g -> (L_g,R_g), with R_g=L_h for every admitted within-group adjacency gh.
design.unit: Literal characters inside complete definite raw groups; freeze alphabet and transcription treatment before testing.
design.contrast: Overlapping pair code versus unconstrained symbol or whole-group notation.
design.prediction: A nontrivial latent alphabet and, for the strict injective variant, distinct endpoint pairs must remain possible after every observed adjacency equality.
design.falsifier: Union-find forces all endpoints equal, or forces distinct written symbols to identical endpoint pairs under the separately stated injective variant.
design.scope_note: RAW_UNSCREENED, unreviewed proposal. No result, sound value, plaintext or execution approval. Homophonic surface choice and alternative segmentation are separate mechanisms.
design.nearest_predecessors: GDT188 fixed symbol bijection; GDT160 edit-operation compatibility; neither inspected report gives overlapping latent endpoint equalities.
